question:
Identify the error in the given sentence.

My colleague always works latest than me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the word "**latest**."
 
• The correct comparative form of "late" should be "**later**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**later than me**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My colleague always works **later than me**."*
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "My colleague"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "always works"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "than me"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
